conclusion.rationale: The patch (0597828) tightens input validation bounds in DHCPv6 message parsing to prevent buffer read-overruns. Both before and after binaries build, link, and run successfully with identical compile-time features (DHCPv6 included). Static analysis confirms both findings are INPUT_CONTRACT_CHANGE (low priority) that only affect malformed/truncated DHCPv6 packets: (1) sz<4 check prevents out-of-bounds read in dhcp6_maybe_relay, and (2) opt6_first() validates option bounds before loop entry. The actual contract verification requires privileged network access (raw sockets) to send crafted packets. Based on static analysis, the patch is a security hardening fix with no impact on valid DHCPv6 inputs. For all valid clients, behavior is unchanged.
